deadline.value: The application deadline for summer or fall is January 15; the department's FAQ gives no year, so the 2027 cycle is used.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the summer or fall semester is January 15th

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are only for US citizens or permanent residents in certain undergraduate programs; none for international students.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are only available for applicants who are US Citizens or Permanent Residents who were involved in specific programs as undergraduates | No fee waivers are available for international students.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional but can improve admission chances.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores and/or FE/PE verification is optional

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department normally does not admit doctoral students unless an advisor and a funding source are identified.
supervisor.quote: The department normally does not admit students to our doctoral programs unless | we have identified an advisor (or co-advisors) and a source of funding for them

funding.value: Financial support is limited, so it cannot be offered to all applicants.
funding.quote: The bad news is that the financial support available is not sufficient | to fund all the students who are seeking support. Therefore, financial support cannot | be offered to all applicants

entry_route.value: Students can be admitted directly to the PhD, and many then complete a master's on the way.
entry_route.quote: students who are admitted directly to the PhD program are able to complete a master's

notes: Offers PhD in Civil Engineering (with concentrations) and PhD in Environmental Engineering; both are on this department page, and the field record covers both.
